source.sqlReaderQuery: WITH ProcessEligibility AS (      SELECT         MEME_CK,          CSCS_ID,          CSPI_ID,          MEPE_EFF_DT      FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG      WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(MEPE_EFF_DT, -1) AND ADD_MONTHS (MEPE_TERM_DT, 3)         AND MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'     ),  MemberClassPlan AS (      SELECT         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (              PARTITION BY s.SBSB_ID             ORDER BY pe.MEPE_EFF_DT DESC         ) AS RowNumber,         s.SBSB_CK,          g.GRGR_ID,         pe.CSCS_ID,          pe.CSPI_ID,           s.SBSB_ID,          s.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,          s.SBSB_MID_INIT,          s.SBSB_LAST_NAME,          s.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL     FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP g      INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC s          ON g.GRGR_CK = s.GRGR_CK      INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER m          ON s.SBSB_CK = m.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN ProcessEligibility pe          ON m.MEME_CK = pe.MEME_CK      WHERE (g.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE '%EGR%' AND g.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE '%GRS%' AND g.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE '%GRX%') )  SELECT      mcp.GRGR_ID,      mcp.CSCS_ID,      mcp.CSPI_ID,      mcp.SBSB_ID,      mcp.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,      mcp.SBSB_MID_INIT,      mcp.SBSB_LAST_NAME,      a.SBAD_ADDR1,      a.SBAD_ADDR2,      a.SBAD_ADDR3,      a.SBAD_CITY,      a.SBAD_STATE,      a.SBAD_ZIP,     ei.BLEI_NET_DUE,      NULL AS BGBG_ID,      NULL AS BGBG_NAME,ei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL FROM MemberClassPlan mcp  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL sd      ON mcp.SBSB_CK = sd.SBSB_CK  inner join FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM sp     ON SD.SBSB_CK = SP.SBSB_CK AND SP.SBSP_EFF_DT=SD.SBSP_EFF_DT INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO ei      ON mcp.SBSB_CK = ei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR a     ON mcp.SBSB_CK = a.SBSB_CK          AND mcp.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = a.SBAD_TYPE            WHERE (     mcp.RowNumber = 1          OR (                 mcp.RowNumber > 1                      AND ei.BLEI_NET_DUE > 0.00         )      )      AND sd.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT'     AND ei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'      AND SYSDATE  BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(SP.SBSP_EFF_DT,-1) AND SP.SBSP_TERM_DT  UNION  SELECT       mcp.GRGR_ID,      mcp.CSCS_ID,      mcp.CSPI_ID,      mcp.SBSB_ID,      mcp.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,      mcp.SBSB_MID_INIT,      mcp.SBSB_LAST_NAME,      a.SBAD_ADDR1,      a.SBAD_ADDR2,      a.SBAD_ADDR3,      a.SBAD_CITY,      a.SBAD_STATE,      a.SBAD_ZIP,     ei.BLEI_NET_DUE,      bg.BGBG_ID,      CASE sd.SBSD_MCTR_STYP         WHEN 'EMPL' THEN bg.BGBG_NAME         ELSE NULL     END AS BGBG_NAME,ei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL FROM MemberClassPlan mcp  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL sd      ON mcp.SBSB_CK = sd.SBSB_CK  inner join FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM sp     ON SD.SBSB_CK = SP.SBSB_CK AND SP.SBSP_EFF_DT=SD.SBSP_EFF_DT INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP bg      ON sd.BGBG_CK = bg.BGBG_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO ei      ON bg.BGBG_CK = ei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR a     ON mcp.SBSB_CK = a.SBSB_CK          AND mcp.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = a.SBAD_TYPE            WHERE  (     mcp.RowNumber = 1          OR (                 mcp.RowNumber > 1                      AND ei.BLEI_NET_DUE > 0.00         )      )      AND sd.SBSD_MCTR_STYP IN ('FAML', 'EMPL')     AND ei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B'     AND SYSDATE  BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(SP.SBSP_EFF_DT,-1) AND SP.SBSP_TERM_DT

SELECT DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID, MEPE.CSPI_ID, SUB.SBSB_ID, SUB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, SUB.SBSB_MID_INIT, SUB.SBSB_LAST_NAME, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3, SBAD.SBAD_CITY, SBAD.SBAD_STATE, SBAD.SBAD_ZIP, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL ,CAST(SBSB_LAST_NAME as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBSB_LAST_NAME},CAST(SBAD_ZIP as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBAD_ZIP},CAST(CSCS_ID as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of CSCS_ID},CAST(SBAD_CITY as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBAD_CITY},CAST(SBSB_MID_INIT as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBSB_MID_INIT},CAST(SBAD_ADDR1 as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBAD_ADDR1},CAST(SBAD_ADDR2 as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBAD_ADDR2},CAST(SBSB_FIRST_NAME as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBSB_FIRST_NAME},CAST(GRGR_ID as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of GRGR_ID},CAST(SBAD_ADDR3 as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBAD_ADDR3},CAST(SBAD_STATE as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBAD_STATE},CAST(SBSB_ID as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of SBSB_ID},CAST(CSPI_ID as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of CSPI_ID} FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SUB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SUB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0' JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP ON SUB.SBSB_CK = BLBP.SBSB_CK AND SUB.GRGR_CK = BLBP.GRGR_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SUB.SBSB_CK = SBAD.SBSB_CK AND SUB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SUB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SUB.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = BLBP.BLBP_CK AND BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'J' JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, -1) AND ADD_MONTHS(MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, 3) AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE2 WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEPE2.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = MEPE2.MEPE_ELIG_IND HAVING MAX(MEPE2.MEPE_EFF_DT) = MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID, MEPE.CSPI_ID, SUB.SBSB_ID, SUB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, SUB.SBSB_MID_INIT, SUB.SBSB_LAST_NAME, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3, SBAD.SBAD_CITY, SBAD.SBAD_STATE, SBAD.SBAD_ZIP, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SUB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SUB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0' JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SUB.SBSB_CK = SBAD.SBSB_CK AND SUB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SUB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SUB.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SUB.SBSB_CK AND BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, -1) AND ADD_MONTHS(MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, 3) AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE2 WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEPE2.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = MEPE2.MEPE_ELIG_IND HAVING MAX(MEPE2.MEPE_EFF_DT) = MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID, MEPE.CSPI_ID, SUB.SBSB_ID, SUB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, SUB.SBSB_MID_INIT, SUB.SBSB_LAST_NAME, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2, SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3, SBAD.SBAD_CITY, SBAD.SBAD_STATE, SBAD.SBAD_ZIP, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SUB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SUB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('KYMCDWP0', 'NYMCD000', 'WIMCDWP0') JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SUB.SBSB_CK = SBAD.SBSB_CK AND SUB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SUB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SUB.SBSB_CK AND BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND SYSDATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, -1) AND ADD_MONTHS(MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, 3) AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE2 WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEPE2.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = MEPE2.MEPE_ELIG_IND HAVING MAX(MEPE2.MEPE_EFF_DT) = MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT )

WITH PROCESSELIGIBILITY AS (      SELECT         MEME_CK,          CSCS_ID,          CSPI_ID,          MEPE_EFF_DT      FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG      WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(MEPE_EFF_DT,-1) AND ADD_MONTHS(MEPE_TERM_DT, 6)         AND MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'     ),  MEMBERCLASSPLAN AS (      SELECT         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (              PARTITION BY S.SBSB_ID             ORDER BY PE.MEPE_EFF_DT DESC         ) AS ROWNUMBER,         S.SBSB_CK,          G.GRGR_ID,         PE.CSCS_ID,          PE.CSPI_ID,           S.SBSB_ID,          S.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,          S.SBSB_MID_INIT,          S.SBSB_LAST_NAME,          S.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL     FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP G      INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC S          ON G.GRGR_CK = S.GRGR_CK      INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER M          ON S.SBSB_CK = M.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN PROCESSELIGIBILITY PE          ON M.MEME_CK = PE.MEME_CK      WHERE (G.GRGR_ID LIKE '%EGR%' OR G.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRS%' OR G.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRX%') )  SELECT      MCP.GRGR_ID,      MCP.CSCS_ID AS CSCS_ID,     MCP.CSPI_ID AS CSPI_ID,     BLID.BLEI_CK,     BLID.BLIV_ID AS INVOICE,     MCP.SBSB_ID AS MEMBERID,      MCP.SBSB_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME,      MCP.SBSB_MID_INIT AS MID_INIT,      MCP.SBSB_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME,      A.SBAD_ADDR1 AS SBAD_ADDR1,      A.SBAD_ADDR2 AS SBAD_ADDR2,      A.SBAD_ADDR3 AS SBAD_ADDR3,      A.SBAD_CITY AS SBAD_CITY,      A.SBAD_STATE AS SBAD_STATE,      A.SBAD_ZIP AS SBAD_ZIP,     BLID.BLEI_NET_DUE AS BLEI_NET_DUE,      NULL AS BGBG_ID,      decode(MCP.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,'','',MCP.SBSB_FIRST_NAME ||' ') ||     decode(MCP.SBSB_MID_INIT,'','',MCP.SBSB_MID_INIT ||' ') || MCP.SBSB_LAST_NAME            AS BGBG_NAME ,EI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS  BLEI_BILL_LEVEL                           FROM MEMBERCLASSPLAN MCP     INNER JOIN (     SELECT SD.SBSB_CK,SD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP     FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SD INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM  SP     ON SD.SBSB_CK = SP.SBSB_CK AND SP.SBSP_EFF_DT=SD.SBSP_EFF_DT      WHERE SYSDATE  BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(ADD_MONTHS(SPE.SBSP_EFF_DT,-1)) SBSP_EFF_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SPE WHERE SPE.SBSB_CK=SD.SBSB_CK)     AND ( SELECT MAX(SPT.SBSP_TERM_DT) SBSP_EFF_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SPT WHERE SPT.SBSB_CK=SD.SBSB_CK)  ) SPN ON SPN.SBSB_CK= MCP.SBSB_CK   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO EI      ON MCP.SBSB_CK = EI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK  INNER JOIN    (     SELECT DISTINCT BLIV.BLEI_CK, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, MAX(BLIV.BLIV_ID) BLIV_ID, MAX(BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM)      FROM FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK       WHERE BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM= (SELECT MAX(BLIV1.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV1                                    WHERE BLIV1.BLIV_CREATE_DTM < SYSDATE AND BLIV1.BLEI_CK=BLEI.BLEI_CK)                                    GROUP BY BLIV.BLEI_CK, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE   ) BLID ON BLID.BLEI_CK =EI.BLEI_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR A     ON MCP.SBSB_CK = A.SBSB_CK          AND MCP.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = A.SBAD_TYPE            WHERE (     MCP.ROWNUMBER = 1          OR (                 MCP.ROWNUMBER > 1                      AND EI.BLEI_NET_DUE > 0.00         )      )      AND SPN.SBSD_MCTR_STYP IN ('EMPL', 'DRCT')     AND EI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'

SELECT DISTINCT   NVL(GRS.GRGR_ID,XWALK.GRGR_ID) AS GRGR_ID,    CS.CSCS_ID AS CSCS_ID,   NULL AS CSPI_ID,    BLID.BLIV_ID AS INVOICE,   BGBG.BGBG_ID  AS MEMBERID,   NULL AS FIRST_NAME,   NULL AS MID_INIT,   NULL AS LAST_NAME,   BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1 AS BG_SBAD_ADDR1,   BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2 AS BG_SBAD_ADDR2,   BGBG.BGBG_ADDR3 AS BG_SBAD_ADDR3,   BGBG.BGBG_CITY  AS BG_SBAD_CITY,   BGBG.BGBG_STATE AS BG_SBAD_STATE,    BGBG.BGBG_ZIP AS BG_SBAD_ZIP,   BLID.BLEI_NET_DUE AS BLEI_NET_DUE,    BGBG.BGBG_ID AS BGBG_ID,   BGBG.BGBG_NAME AS BGBG_NAME ,BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS  BLEI_BILL_LEVEL  FROM FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG  INNER JOIN AGP.BILLING_EGR_BGBG_XWALK XWALK       ON XWALK.BGBG_ID = BGBG.BGBG_ID        LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT GRGR_ID, BGBG_ID FROM AGP.BILLING_EGR_BGBG_XWALK WHERE GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRS%') GRS         ON XWALK.BGBG_ID = GRS.BGBG_ID        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR          ON GRGR.GRGR_ID = NVL(GRS.GRGR_ID,XWALK.GRGR_ID)          AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%EGR%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRS%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRX%')          AND GRGR.GRGR_BILL_LEVEL='B'  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CSCS_CLASS CS         ON CS.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI     ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B'      INNER JOIN    (     SELECT DISTINCT BLIV.BLEI_CK, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, MAX(BLIV.BLIV_ID) BLIV_ID,     MAX(BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM)      FROM FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLIV.BLEI_CK       WHERE BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM= (SELECT MAX(BLIV1.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV1                                    WHERE BLIV1.BLIV_CREATE_DTM < SYSDATE AND  BLIV1.BLEI_CK=BLEI.BLEI_CK)      GROUP BY BLIV.BLEI_CK, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE         ) BLID ON BLID.BLEI_CK =BLEI.BLEI_CK    WHERE BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE > 0  AND SYSDATE BETWEEN BGBG.BGBG_ORIG_EFF_DT AND ADD_MONTHS(BGBG.BGBG_TERM_DT, 6)
